article.title: Edad мне 30 лет
article.part: Posesión y experiencia — Посессивность и опыт
article.chapter: Posesión, existencia y construcciones experienciales — Посессивность, существование и экспериенциальные конструкции

claims.summary: In Russian, age is typically expressed with the person in the dative case and a number followed by год, года or лет. For example, Мне 30 лет means 'I am 30 years old'.
The construction does not use a direct verb equivalent to 'have'. The basic schema is datative of the person + number + form of 'year'. The word for 'year' changes according to Russian numeral rules.
Provides examples of age expressions in Russian using the dative case, such as Мне 30 лет, Ей 21 год, Моему брату 23 года, and Ребёнку 5 лет.

Mentions that 'мне' should not be analyzed as an implicit nominative subject or translated word-for-word from Spanish. It explains the role of the dative case in identifying the person related to the age and the core informative component of the expression.
